mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate from t-2mo to t-1mo reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS declined by at least 0.1 percentage points from t-2mo to t-1mo.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from t-2mo to t-1mo indicates weakening consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from t-2mo to t-1mo
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline from t-2mo to t-1mo.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 250), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months within high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 250) where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) from t-2mo to t-1mo boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of months where PAYEMS increased by at least 50,000 from t-2mo to t-1mo.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (2017=100 base) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate production capacity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in GDP (GDPC1) below 18,000 and housing starts (HOUST) below 1,200 signals broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate profit growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months where GDPC1 is below 18,000 and HOUST is below 1,200.

mechanism_narrative: In housing market contraction (HOUST < 1,200), a simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 500,000) signals severe demand shock, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of months within housing market contraction (HOUST < 1,200) where RSAFS is below 500,000.
